steps: Choose Open 1145 Lifestyle. The link leaves this website and opens 1145.io.
Create an account, or sign in if you already have one. You do this on 1145.io, never on this website.
Start shopping, or register as a merchant to open a store.
notes: 1145 Lifestyle is live for online use as a web app.
The web app is updated continuously, so it does not have a version number here. The date shown is when it was listed on this website.
known_issues: There are no mobile apps to download yet. Use the web app in your phone’s browser.

support_route: Use the help and contact options on 1145.io for anything about your account, an order, a ride or a payment.
